limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter but also made `ready_a` high during reset and allowed a bit to be accepted on the first edge after reset release, whereas the reference preserves the registered ready signal.
The rewrite asserts `valid_b` only when the sixth bit is accepted, whereas the reference preserves the count-only assertion even on idle cycles after five accepted bits.
The test drove reset and idle-at-five cases but expected the rewritten handshake behavior, so its pass did not verify that the original ready and valid timing was preserved.
